JOB TITLE:  Senior Engineer – Quality (QA/QC - Site)

Work Location: ADNOC Das Island Site

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Quality Assurance:

·         Ensure implementation and maintenance of the Construction quality plan.

·         Prepares / reviews quality related procedures required during the Construction phase  

·         Supports Site QC Manager and Project team in resolving QMS coordination and technical issues related with various ISO certification standards such as ISO9001, ISO 29001etc.

·         Preparation of Construction Quality Assurance Program/ Construction Audit schedule which includes subcontractors, encompassing areas which specific emphasis on project such as cleanliness, tightness, welding, preservation etc.. 

·         Review and approve the Subcontractors QA related deliverables

·         Review project audit performance, identify and report problems or trends of quality performance.

·         Approve, recommend and/or implement appropriate corrective actions to quality problems.

·         Conducts inductions / trainings on project QMS for all the project personnel as well as the subcontractor teams as required and monitor the toolbox talk.

·         Participate in customer feedback process, monitors customer satisfaction rating and initiates appropriate corrective actions to improve the same.

·         Ensures the customer complaints are logged and appropriate actions are taken on-time to close out the same.

·         Organize / Conduct internal audits which includes preparation audit plan, Audit report coordination with Auditee.

·         Maintain the site action tracking which includes non-conformance(s), Corrective Action, Daily surveillance report and monitor the closure and effectiveness of corrective action.

·         Coordinates and records regular quality meetings with Client

·         Compiles project QMS performance report which includes KPI’s as a input to Project Management review and Corporate Quality Director

·         Coordinates and records Project QMS Review Meetings during the construction and monitors closeout actions.

·         Coordinates client and third party audits and follow-up action closure

·         Ensure the implementation of Lesson Learned and report the new lessons to Project LL coordinator

Quality control

·         Review and approve site ITPs, QCPs and ITRs based on corporate standard.

·         Develop tag type matrix based on approved ITPs and ITRs.

·         Close coordination with Completions to ensure correct ITRs are forecasted in PetroPCS.

·         Coordinate with all the site sub-contractors to ensure timely inspection/ testing on site.

·         Coordinate with the customers representative on all quality matters.

·         Coordinate all receipt inspections.

·         Verify that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the applicable codes and

standards.

·         Participate in the internal and external site audits.

·         Coordinate all the quality site inspections through the site QC inspectors.

·         Ensure all ITRs are prepared and submitted to Completions on a daily basis.

·         Control all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action.

·         Complete site quality control instructions and action remedial responses.

·         Review the customers specification and undertake relevant training to the site QC inspector.

·         Monitor the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.

·         Complete and coordinate the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.

·         Arrange tool box talks/training in coordination with subcontractors.

·         Assure all technical documents relative to site quality control are current status.

·         Supervise Sub-contractor QC personnel.

·         Prepare daily surveillance reports, attend quality walkthroughs and report issues which need to

·         circulated as a quality alert

·         Controller (QA/QC) as relevant to support the quality activity.

·         Align quality resources with business needs and assure effective coverage of the project load

·         Assure all technical documents relative to site quality control are current status.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

·         Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

·         CSWIP film interpretation/CSWIP 3.2.2/ RTFI Level II Certification for RT Interpretation.

·         CSWIP/ PCN Certification in Welding.

·         QMS Lead Auditor or Auditor certification.

·         Should have experience in oil & gas/petrochemical industry

·         Should have previously worked with major EPC contractors or their subcontractors
